text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
A brand new Bakushin—Supernova Super 
Bakushin! I will never give up first 
place...! Haaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O takes the lead! Bakushin O 
takes the lead! In the front is Sakura 
Bakushin O!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Nghh!! Bakushin O-chan...!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(I can't reach her, I can't catch her...! 
So this is Bakushin O-chan's—true 
weapon!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In the lead is Sakura Bakushin O!! Sakura 
Bakushin O takes the G1 victory!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And from here, the King of Speed's all-out 
dash begins!!
(Uwoooooah!!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Allllriiiight!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Did you see that, everyone?! That's what 
you get when you Bakushin from Controlled 
Bakushin! It's the result of immense 
growth!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Model speed! A model race! The fastest one 
of all is ME!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Class Rep really does suit me best! The 
title of 'Model Strongest' is mine!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Mmhmm, my speed is absolutely amazing! It 
can't get any better than this—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Mmh? My heart feels restless, somehow.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Isn't Bakushin O way too strong? 
Neither Flower, who won last year, nor 
Zephyr, who's aiming for a three-division 
sweep... could reach her.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Isn't she a legit "King"...? From here on 
out, it's the era of Bakushin O!

The venue is buzzing over Sakura Bakushin 
O's overwhelming strength. Having faced 
her head-on, I'm a bit worried about North 
Flight's mental state...

"Yet, she was gazing at Sakura Bakushin O— 
with eyes full of sparkling admiration."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Amazing...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing, Bakushin O-chan. You 
really are... so stylish!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: You are speed itself...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(I want to polish my raw materials even 
more... and clash against you.)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"With my own brilliance. I want to beat 
you—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ngh!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"A heart-pounding, fiery gaze!! From 
where...—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ! Flight-san!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. Hehehehe...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bwahaha!! That's the spirit!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I shall face your fighting spirit head-on! 
As the Class Rep!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(Bakushin O-chan is looking at me. Almost 
as if she's waiting for me.)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"...Here I go. I will definitely—reach 
you!"
